transcriber_notes: Measured on the embedded chart raster (6160x2832 px) inside the PDF. Boundaries printed on the right axis and confirmed in the plot (14.26 px/cm; 1 cm crust layers 60-59 and 35-34 and the 5 cm step confirmed). Hardness from bar left edges vs grey gridlines (260 px per class, bars grow leftward from F; thirds read as +/-). Temperature: continuous polyline without point markers; recorded the break points (intersections of fitted segments), 0 C at the right edge of the bar area (x=2115 px, about 8 px right of the '0°C' label centre), 46.65 px/C; the dashed segment above the surface ends at -17.8 C = printed air temp (calibration check) and all break points fall on 0.5 C steps; +-0.1 C. Temperature values were corrected from an earlier label-based calibration (0 C at the '0°C' label centre), which read them ~0.1-0.2 C too warm. Collinear intermediate measurement points cannot be recovered. Labels: Avanet draws label leaders and red lines at the bottom of the layer above the named height; the three SH labels (no SH layer in the grain column) were treated as interfaces (date_tag on the layer whose top is at the leader height); the MFC/crust labels name the 1 cm crust layers directly. Chart date 2018-02-11 differs from file name/record_id 2018-02-10; chart location 'Sunshine Study Plot'.
